4 The monastery of the Pantocrator was then inhabited by monks not uncultivated,

5 Krumbacher, Sitzungsb. der Akad. München, 1894, p. 437, thought that Glycas wrote his letter to Manuel
already an old man (in the last years of Manuel's life),
but with new testimonies now adduced I trust that he will change his opinion.

summary.headline: Manuel Comnenus and Astrology
summary.text: Discussion of Byzantine attitudes toward astrology under Manuel Comnenus: clerical opposition, patriarchal condemnation, Manuel’s defense of astrology as lawful and scripturally supported, and Michael Glycas’s rebuttal. The text also recounts Manuel’s alleged astrological errors, his monastic repentance, and the political aftermath of Glycas’s criticism.
